item.tib: gsang mchog ma rgyud kyi lha sum brgya drug cu'i sgrub pa'i gzhung
item.coloph: rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs kyis grub pa bsnyems pa yang gsang gi rgyud do / … dung phor gter nas gu ru rnon rtses bton pa'i dar dkar ngos nas gnyal ston gzhon nu 'bum gyis bris nas dag par gtugs so
item.note: the text is complete and in order, but the numbering of the pages is faulty. pp. 245-248 are not found, p. 252 is followed by 263; p. 266 is followed by 253-260; p. 260 is followed by 267; the order of pp. 335 and 336 is inverted; pp. 347 and 348 are missing; p. 353 is repeated twice (p. 354 missing). p. 374 is blank (not paginated). the title in ytkc is given as: gsang sngags ma rgyud kyi lha sum brgya drug cu'i bsgrub pa.
